header.description: What: a SHOW on the real OSM terrain Stechovice (Vltava valley + village, imported on first use) - two ground battles and an air war. Scenario coordinates (the terrain south-west corner is 0,0). RIVERBANK (y about 1570): a Blue platoon (x about 970) (leader + 3 squads, PlatoonDefend) dug in on the flat east bank with an IFV, two M1s, an HMG technical and a HMMWV fires across the river at a Red platoon (leader + 3 squads, x about 765) with three technicals (HMG, DShK) and two T-72s on the low west terrace, ~200 m across the water (the plateau behind it is a wooded cliff nobody sees out of). VILLAGE (centre x about 1690, y about 2265): a Blue platoon (leader + 3 squads, PlatoonAttack) with four M1 tanks, three Bradleys, two HMMWVs and two HMG technicals advances from the east (x about 2250-2370) into the village; a Red platoon (leader + 3 squads, PlatoonDefend) holds the houses with an AT team (2 gunners), three T-72s and six technicals (3 HMG, ATGM, 2 DShK), and a Red radar SAM and a ZU-23 sit on the hill to the north (~330 m). AIR: Blue HQ (SupportCommand) owns both platoons, a Blue Apache that attacks the village technical inside the SAM cover and a Blue A-10 that strikes the hill ZU-23 flying in from the west over the river. AIR COMBAT: two Blue F-16s from the east and two Red MiG-29s from the west, each pilot on a named bandit, merge over the valley (an arena 4 km round the centre). Every soldier is Playable (a free one runs as AI until a Player takes him). SUMO background traffic (250 cars, 60 pedestrians) runs on the terrain roads. Chain of command Blue: HQ > platoon > squad > man; Red: platoon > squad > man. Behaviours as authored, nothing scripted. Judge (checks.json): both battles trade fire and cost both sides casualties; the Blue attackers reach the village; the Apache flies over the village and the A-10 over the river; the Red air defence (ZU-23, SAM) fires at them. Generated by scripts/stechovice_battle_scenario.py; first run imports the terrain (minutes), then caches it.
